articles.summary: Kemper Corporation (NYSE: KMPR) Kemper Corporation (NYSE: KMPR) today announced preliminary financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, reflecting sequential improvement in consolidated operating earnings and Specialty Auto underwriting performance. “We are pleased with the improvement in our third quarter results, but we have more work to do,” said Stephen J. McAnena, President and Chief Executive Officer. “Our focus remains on disciplined execution and returning Kemper to consistent, sustainable profitability.” Preliminary Third Quarter Financial Highlights* Net Income is expected to be approximately $52 million, or $0.88 per diluted share, compared with a net loss of $465 million, or $7.90 per share, in the second quarter of 2026. Adjusted Consolidated Net Operating Income1 is expected to be approximately $60 million, or $1.01 per diluted share, compared with $26 million, or $0.45 per share, in the second quarter of 2026.
